ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, shareholders, directors and authorized signatories against: UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions List, Interpol notices, and the Vanuatu domestic sanctions list maintained by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU). Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is compulsory for (i) Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), (ii) high-risk medical device trading counterparties, and (iii) jurisdictions on FATF watch lists. Ongoing transaction monitoring applies post-incorporation under the AML/CFT Act No. 11 of 2020.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry and Name Clearance Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu); applications are lodged through VFSC-licensed Registered Agents holding e-access credentials.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be registered in Latin-script English/French/Bislama character sets; no mandatory local-script transliteration. Names must contain a limited-liability token: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme', 'SA', or 'Company'. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name or reserved name in the VFSC register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Medical Device terms implying regulatory approval absent VFSC review (e.g., 'Certified', 'Licensed', 'Accredited')
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant's registered agent may file a written appeal with the VFSC Corporate Registry Director within 14 calendar days of the notice, attaching a legal memorandum distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting marks and evidencing any prior ministerial consents for sensitive tokens. If the refusal is based on similarity, the appellant may submit a letter of no-objection from the prior name holder. The Director must determine the appeal within 14 working days; rejected applicants may re-file with an amended name after paying a fresh search fee. Extension of a cleared name is available for one additional 30-day period upon written request and payment of the prescribed reservation extension fee, provided incorporation has not lapsed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a substitute for the statutory registered office. An International Company must maintain a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent within Vanuatu at all times; the office may be the agent's premises or a physically staffed local address. Virtual-office-only arrangements do not satisfy section of the International Companies Act [Cap 222] requiring service of process and statutory records at a real, accessible address in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate risk, quantified at approximately 15-25% for an International Company engaged in intraocular lens manufacturing due to the high-risk/high-value medical device classification, cross-border payment rails (Swift Wire, Letter of Credit), and elevated bank/financial institution KYC scrutiny; the VFSC conducts risk-based, unannounced on-site inspections and may delegate inspections to the VFIU or external auditors upon any AML trigger event. Under normal low-risk conditions with a compliant local registered agent, routine inspection probability is below 10% per annum.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222], sections 4 (incorporation), 5 (memorandum and articles), 7 (registered office), 9 (registered agent), 11 (restrictions on carrying on business), 15 (share capital) and 28 (directors); supplemented by the Companies (Amendment) Act and the International Companies (Fees) Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 — Application for Registration of an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and Form 2 — Declaration of Compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed by the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; the standard authorized capital is USD 50,000 divided into 50,000 no-par-value shares, and the incorporation fee scales with authorized capital. No escrow account is legally mandated at formation; the VFSC requires only settlement of registration fees, and a commercial bank may require a minimum opening deposit of approximately USD 2,500 for the corporate account.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the first meeting of the board of directors of [COMPANY NAME] (the Company): 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION — The Company accepts the subscription of 10,000 ordinary shares of no par value, issued at USD 1.00 per share, to the founding subscriber, and the directors are authorized to issue shares for future manufacturing finance. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE — The registered office is fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the agent is approved to receive process and official notices. 3. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS — [NAME] is appointed Director and Chief Executive Officer; [NAME] is appointed Company Secretary; [NAME] is appointed Chief Financial Officer, each serving until the next annual general meeting. 4. BANKING — The directors are authorized to open corporate bank accounts and to execute banking documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Registry, acting through a licensed VFSC registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name, with three alternative names, to the VFSC Companies Registry through an approved registered agent for availability confirmation; execute the Registered Agent Services Agreement and obtain the registered office address consent letter; pay the name reservation fee of approximately VT 10,000 (USD 90) unless it is bundled with the incorporation fee.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and three alternative names
Registered Agent Services Agreement
Passport copy and proof of residential address of the applicant and beneficial owner
Contact details and consent of the first director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, immediately submit the next alternative name; if the registered agent refuses engagement due to insufficient KYC documentation, add a bank reference letter and re-submit within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Constitutional Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu legal counsel or notary public engaged by the Company; final conformity review by the VFSC Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct licensed counsel to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], including an objects clause authorizing the design, high-precision lathe turning, sterilization, packaging and global distribution of foldable hydrophobic intraocular acrylic lenses; have the subscriber and first director(s) execute the instrument and notarize signatures, with legalization or apostille where executed outside Vanuatu; retain certified copies for the VFSC file.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and final)
Statement of Subscriber
Consent to Act as Director
Notarized passport copies of the officers and subscriber
Registered agent consent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC review identifies an object clause deficiency, adopt a board resolution amending the constitution and re-execute with notarization; if foreign notarization is defective, obtain an apostille or consular legalization and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Incorporation Filing, Fee Transfer and Defect Cure
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — Registry of International Companies (online ComPany lodgment and VFSC cashier counter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 with the authenticated constitution, Form 2 Declaration of Compliance, registered agent consent and registered office address; pay the government registration fee of USD 250 or approximately VT 30,000 via telegraphic transfer or at the VFSC cashier; select standard processing of 48 hours or expedited same-day processing; obtain the lodgment receipt and corporate file number.
required_dossiers: Form 1 — Application for Registration of an International Company
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form 2 — Declaration of Compliance
Registered office and registered agent consents
Payment receipt for the VFSC registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, the applicant has 14 days to file a written response; upon rejection, appeal to the Registrar or the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; if the fee is deficient, pay the shortfall together with the late-filing penalty before issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate Issuance, Post-Incorporation Records and Banking Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Certificate Issuance Desk; company secretary; international bank licensed in Port Vila or an offshore banking center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation and certified copies of the registered instruments; verify the company number, name and incorporation date; maintain statutory registers of directors, shareholders, beneficial owners and charges; adopt the first board resolution; pass the bank mandate and open a corporate settlement account supporting SWIFT wire and letter-of-credit payment rails.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
First Board Resolutions (share subscription, registered office, officer appointments and bank mandate)
Statutory registers and Beneficial Ownership Register
Bank account opening pack (corporate KYC, UBO declaration, bank reference letters)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the account at KYC review, resubmit under the bank's corporate products and provide the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; if any statutory register is inaccurate, file a rectification notice with the VFSC Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notification and Pre-Licensing Clearance for Medical Device Manufacturing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA); Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives; Ministry of Health — Product Quality Control Unit; Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation; Port Vila Municipal Council
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Foreign Investment Certificate application with VIPA where the beneficial owner is non-resident; record the IC with the Department of Industry for sector oversight; pre-apply to the Ministry of Health and the Vanuatu Bureau of Standards for classification as a Class III implantable medical device manufacturing facility; submit the site plan to DEPC and the Municipal Council for environmental tier assignment and building code compliance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and constitutional documents
Foreign Investment Certificate application (VIPA form)
Factory site lease or land ownership certificate
Manufacturing process description and material safety data sheets for acrylic monomers
Draft ISO 13485 quality management system plan
Architectural and structural drawings of the cleanroom facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VIPA raises investment screening conditions, respond with a remediation letter or restructure the local shareholding participation; if DEPC requires a preliminary environmental assessment, commission an approved consultant and file the PEA report within 30 days; if the Municipal Council rejects the site plan, revise the drawings and resubmit with stamped structural certification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (International Companies Desk), Department of Industry of the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives, and Ministry of Health — Product Quality Control Unit, acting jointly for medical device manufacturing authorization
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Manufacturing Facility License — Class III Intraocular Acrylic Lens Production, issued with the onshore business permission for an International Company

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards and Energy
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — Preliminary Environmental Assessment and Registration; the cleanroom lens manufacturing activity is below the full EIA threshold under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap. 283] and the Waste Management Regulations, but requires a site-specific PEA registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero liquid effluent discharge for polishing and photopolymerization rinse streams; total volatile organic compound concentration in the lathe and cleanroom workrooms not exceeding 20 mg/m3 consistent with the WHO/IFC Environmental Health and Safety Guidelines; wastewater, where treated, must meet pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 below 25 mg/L, TSS below 35 mg/L and site-specific heavy metal limits; acrylic grinding dust captured by HEPA filtration with 99.97% minimum collection efficiency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service after inspection of flammable solvent cabinets, compressed-gas storage and emergency exhaust systems; structural load certification of the cleanroom slab from the Port Vila Municipal Building Control Unit covering vibration-isolated lathe plinths; occupational health clearance from the Department of Labour under the Occupational Health and Safety Act [Cap. 36] including ventilation verification, eye-wash stations and medical surveillance for personnel handling acrylic monomers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://www.vrc.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must apply for a VAT registration identification number using VRC Form VAT 1 lodged with the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs office. Required supporting documents include certified memorandum and articles of incorporation, proof of business address, bank reference, and evidence of projected taxable turnover. For an International Company, the VFSC certificate of incorporation is the primary corporate document; the IC is exempt from income tax but must obtain a VAT ID only if it makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu. Foreign entities without physical presence in Vanuatu are generally not required to register for VAT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No direct income tax election exists in Vanuatu for International Companies; tax-exempt status is automatic under the International Companies Act. For VAT, voluntary registration is available where annual taxable turnover does not exceed the compulsory threshold. No check-the-box, fiscal unity, or hybrid mismatch election is recognized under Vanuatu domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover (compulsory); voluntary registration permitted below this threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoice clearance, digital stamping, or government API filing regime is currently implemented. Registered businesses must issue VAT invoices containing prescribed particulars and retain records for seven years. No fiscal electronic transaction control is mandated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exported goods, provided the goods leave Vanuatu within 28 days of supply and the exporter holds documentary evidence of export. Services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply are zero-rated if the services do not relate to land or goods situated in Vanuatu and are not enjoyed in Vanuatu. Intraocular acrylic lenses manufactured under ISIC 3250 qualify when sold to foreign ophthalmology distributors and shipped outside Vanuatu under a valid customs export declaration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic or manual submission to Vanuatu Customs)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Certificate of origin (where preferential tariff treatment is claimed)
VAT zero-rating refund application and supporting input tax documents
Bank SWIFT credit advice or payment evidence (Inward Remittance Certificate is not mandatory due to absence of exchange controls)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Where zero-rating is claimed without documented export evidence, Vanuatu Revenue and Customs may assess output VAT at 12.5% plus statutory interest and impose civil penalties up to 200% of the tax avoided. Fraudulent documentation can result in criminal prosecution and imprisonment under the Value Added Tax Act. Retrospective assessments may extend for six years from the end of the relevant tax period. There is no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline in Vanuatu.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — the sole statutory monetary authority, foreign-exchange administrator, banking supervisor and national payment system operator. Governing legal instruments: Exchange Control Act [Cap 96], Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125], Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2019 (as amended by the July 2024 AML/CFT package), Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 14 of 2024, International Companies Act [Cap 222], and Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 265]. The RBV licenses authorized dealers (commercial banks), enforces export-proceeds surrender obligations, approves foreign-currency retention accounts, and issues exchange-control directions applicable to the VFSC-special-licensed International Company (VU_IC).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV operates under a managed-float with practical full convertibility for current-account trade transactions; all FX transactions must execute through an RBV-supervised authorized dealer. Capital-account items — share capital subscription, intercompany loans, trade credit and equity injections from non-resident shareholders — are permitted for a licensed International Company, but each inward transfer requires an authorized-dealer purpose declaration, UBO source-of-funds attestation and automatic RBV balance-of-payments statistical reporting. Profit, dividend, royalty and management-fee remittances to non-residents are free of Vanuatu withholding tax and do not require RBV pre-approval, yet banks impose documentary hurdles (tax-exemption certificate, audited financial statements, licensed-agent good-standing certificate) to rebut shell-company indicators. For the intraocular acrylic lens trade, export invoices in USD/EUR/AUD settle freely; local-cost payments (salaries, facilities, agent fees) must be converted to VUV unless a Foreign Currency Retention Account has been RBV-approved. The convertibility stress point is documentary, not fiscal: medical-device (ISIC 3250) transactions attract enhanced due diligence from authorized dealers and correspondents, particularly on purpose-code consistency and end-user verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Codified under Exchange Control Act [Cap 96] and the RBV's authorized-dealer exchange-control directions: (i) export proceeds from the sale of foldable hydrophobic intraocular lenses must be received in full no later than 180 days after shipment; (ii) upon receipt, the foreign currency must be offered for sale to an authorized dealer in exchange for VUV within 30 days — a default 100% surrender obligation, relaxable only through an RBV-approved foreign-currency retention authorization matched against the IC's import obligations for hydrophobic acrylic polymer feedstocks and precision lathe consumables; (iii) each physical export shipment requires an exchange-control permit or an authorized-dealer endorsement on the commercial invoice before dispatch, with the bank returning the endorsed invoice to the RBV for surrender reconciliation; (iv) non-surrender, late surrender or under-invoicing exposes the IC to monetary penalties, debarment from designated-dealer status and potential account-freezing orders. Treasury control procedure: one dedicated USD collection account at the primary clearing bank with a standing instruction to sweep approved retention amounts daily and convert residual balances to VUV within the 30-day window.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operational VUV Account + USD Retention Account
Operational Multi-Currency Account (VUV/USD/AUD/EUR) + Trade Finance and LC Desk
Operational Multi-Currency Account + Documentary Letter of Credit and Forward FX Facilities

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited (verify current licensed status after ANZ Pacific retail divestitures)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW — legally and operationally constrained. Offshore digital EMI platforms (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Mercury, MultiPass, Currencycloud-based programs) generally decline VFSC-licensed International Companies engaged in a High_Risk_Special_License medical-device trade because Vanuatu has no EU/UK EMI passporting equivalence and EMIs have no access to the RBV-operated national payment and settlement facility for VUV clearing. The Exchange Control Act [Cap 96] prohibits the IC from conducting foreign-exchange transactions through unauthorized persons, rendering EMI-based collection of export proceeds unlawful unless a licensed authorized dealer sits beneath the EMI arrangement as the legal clearing counterparty. Viable architecture: use BSP or BRED as the onshore clearing layer and, if treasury concentration is desired in Australia/Hong Kong, establish a separately incorporated, commercially substantive distribution affiliate — never route the Vanuatu IC's export invoices directly through an EMI. Additional blocker: virtually all EMIs impose physical-presence and payroll-location tests that a tax-exempt IC in Vanuatu cannot satisfy.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hybrid requirement. Under the AML/CFT Act No. 14 of 2024 and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2019, BSP and BRED accept standard corporate opening with a VFSC-licensed registered-agent introduction plus one live, liveness-verified video KYC interview with the compliance officer for each authorized signatory and each director. NBV (state-owned) in practice requires the physical appearance of at least one director or of a notarized attorney-in-fact at the Port Vila branch for escrow and state-facilitated accounts. For this high-risk special-license IC, the uniform bank mandate is: (1) recorded video KYC conference; (2) in-person co-signature by the registered agent at the bank branch; (3) certified passport copies of all natural-person UBOs owning 10% or more; and (4) board resolution designating two authorized signatories with dual-signature authority above USD 10,000. Remote-only opening, without the licensed agent physically appearing, is not available in Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company + VFSC Special License + cross-border medical-device trade flagged by bank screening engines as potential shell-company, letterbox or trade-based money-laundering (TBML) arrangement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver: certificate of incorporation; VFSC current special license; registered-agent good-standing letter; two years' audited financial statements; genuine-economic-purpose file comprising ISO 13485 certificate, TGA/CE/FDA clearances for foldable hydrophobic lenses, raw-material purchase orders for acrylic polymer feedstock, lathe-cell equipment lease, and a 12-month cash-flow projection; plus an economic-substance self-assessment confirming that management and the registered office operate in Vanuatu within permitted IC parameters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity — nominee shareholder or cascading offshore trust concealing the natural-person principal, a common FATF-risk indicator for Pacific offshore centers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver: signed beneficial-ownership declaration on the bank's CDD template; notarized passport copies of all natural-person UBOs; source-of-wealth letter supported by 12 months of personal bank statements and professional-income or transaction documentation; full trust deed and nominee declaration if a nominee director chain exists; and a Certificate of Incumbency issued by the registered agent detailing the precise shareholding and control chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export-proceeds surrender-rule mismatch — the bank observes USD export receipts retained on balance without an RBV retention approval, indicating exchange-control evasion or TBML.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver: per-shipment RBV-endorsed export invoices; incoming SWIFT MT103 credit advices; standing FX conversion instruction to VUV; RBV retention approval letter (where USD balances are held); monthly surrender reconciliation statement signed by the registered agent; and corresponding supplier payment orders evidencing import offset for hydrophobic acrylic raw materials.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 3250 medical-device categorization tripped by automated dual-use and chemical-precursor screening — the acrylic monomers and PMMA feedstocks are initially mischaracterized as potentially divertible industrial chemicals.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver: binding customs classification rulings for the intraocular lens product (e.g., US HTS 9001.30/9021.39 or equivalent EU/CN codes); ISO 13485:2016 quality-management certificate; CE-Mark and importing-country regulatory clearances; end-user undertakings from ophthalmology hospital procurement departments; and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for each acrylic feedstock demonstrating medical-grade, non-precursor status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Video-KYC identity-spoofing suspicion — a failed or degraded liveness check during the recorded interview (poor lighting, PPE worn in the production environment, network latency) triggering an automated high-risk outcome.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver: notarially signed interview attendance sheet; liveness-check transaction log issued by the bank-approved identity-verification platform; supplementary in-person attestation and co-signature by the VFSC registered agent; biometrically verified passport dossier prepared by a Vanuatu notary; and device fingerprint plus IP-geolocation report obtained from the director's video session.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity injections must route as SWIFT MT103 from the remitting shareholder's bank to the beneficiary's Capital Escrow Account at NBV, BSP or BRED. Field 70 (Remittance Information) must read verbatim: 'VU_IC — SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION — INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES ACT [CAP 222]' or '/INV/ EQUITY — VU_IC — VFSC FILE [number]'. Field 72 must restate the VFSC file number and IC registration number. The receiving authorized dealer will block the credit unless: (a) board resolution authorizing the capital call is pre-submitted; (b) the updated share register is deposited with the bank; (c) source-of-funds attestation from the remitting shareholder is provided; and (d) all UBOs clear the FIU sanctions and PEP screen. On completion of the subscription, the bank internally debits the escrow account and credits the operational account upon presentation of the signed share certificate, and automatically files the international-transfer report with the Vanuatu FIU and the RBV balance-of-payments unit. Recommended staging: day 1 — escrow deposit; day 2 — share certificate issuance and sweep to the operational USD/VUV account; day 3 — disbursement against equipment purchase agreements for surgical-grade lathe cells.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing instruments: (1) Supplier prepayments for hydrophobic acrylic feedstocks and precision components — SWIFT MT103 with Field 70 'TRADE PREPAYMENT — MEDICAL DEVICE RAW MATERIALS — PO [number]' plus the proforma invoice, HS classification and VFSC special license attachment; the paying authorized dealer verifies the approved import ledger and applies the 180-day export-reconciliation rule. (2) Documentary credits — irrevocable sight Letter of Credit issued via MT700 under UCP600 for FDA/CE-certified component purchases from Europe and Asia, employing the bank's USD correspondent chain (HSBC, Citi or ANZ New York for BSP/BRED networks); presentation documents must include the ocean/air waybill, commercial invoice, ISO 13485 certificate and independent inspection certificate. (3) Export collections for hospital distributors in Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific — SWIFT MT400/MT402 documentary collection instruments. (4) Domestic VUV-denominated salary, rent and agent-fee disbursements clear through the RBV-operated national payment and settlement facility using local clearing codes, requiring no SWIFT. All trade disbursements above the statutory reporting threshold trigger automatic FIU review for TBML indicators; the IC must maintain a two-person authorized signatory control with a second independent verification for values above USD 10,000.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: VUV/USD outright FX forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months) through an authorized dealer, supported by firm export receivables from intraocular lens sales and simultaneous trade-paper submission; mark-to-market premiums payable in VUV.

VUV/USD cross-currency swap through a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank for capital or equipment-finance liability matching, subject to RBV notification and demonstration of real balance-sheet exposure.

USD/VUV non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing the offshore VUV fixing — permissible only as a hedge of a confirmed trade receivable and executed through an RBV-authorized dealer; naked or speculative NDF positions by the Vanuatu IC are prohibited under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 96].

VUV/EUR and VUV/AUD forward contracts structured through BRED or BSP dealing desks when underlying invoices are denominated in EUR (European ophthalmology distributors) or AUD (Australian hospital networks).

Natural hedging via an RBV-approved Foreign Currency Retention Account — retaining USD export proceeds up to the approved ceiling to offset future USD import bills for acrylic monomers and consumables, thereby reducing reliance on derivatives.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company License Fee Tier 1 (authorized capital up to USD 10,000) - no separate annual return or financial statement is filed for Vanuatu International Companies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each anniversary of incorporation; VFSC grants an administrative 30-day processing grace before assessing late penalties.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a statutory surcharge (approx. 10% of the fee); persistent non-payment for about six months after the due date exposes the company to a VFSC strike-off notice and eventual deregistration; restoration requires full arrears, a reinstatement fee, and registrar approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Licensed Registered Agent Annual Renewal of Appointment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (statutory records kept at the Vanuatu registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; the agent renews its consent concurrently with the VFSC license fee payment each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Continuous maintenance of a registered office and licensed agent is mandatory; a lapse exceeding the statutory period is a strike-off ground and the company cannot validly conduct proceedings or execute contracts until the appointment is restored.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Register of Members Compliance Refresh (AML/CFT annual client review; not a public filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (records retained at registered office; no public UBO register exists in Vanuatu)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation as part of the agent's annual AML/CFT re-verification cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incomplete or outdated beneficial ownership information obliges the agent to escalate to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and VFSC; continued non-cooperation allows the agent to resign (a statutory strike-off trigger) and may attract VFSC administrative fines under the AML Code of Practice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency (annual banking / counterparty due diligence pack)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), issued through the resident registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Issued within 3-7 business days upon written request; regularly refreshed annually to support bank account reviews and payment-rail maintenance (SWIFT/Wire and Letters of Credit).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not a statutory annual filing; however, absence or staleness of the certificate prevents bank re-approval and can trigger covenant breaches under financing and trade documents.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. Under the International Companies Act Cap 222, a Vanuatu International Company is exempt from statutory audit, auditor appointment, and financial statement filing with VFSC regardless of size, turnover, or assets. An audit becomes mandatory only if the entity obtains a local (non-IC) license, an FIA local-presence certificate, or if a bank or investor contractually requires audited IFRS financial statements; medical-device manufacturing activity alone does not create an audit duty.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory GAAP prescribed for International Companies; IFRS is the market standard where voluntary audit or parent-group consolidation applies. If the company later establishes a Vanuatu domestic-license presence, IFRS-compliant local books are expected by VFSC and banks.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Companies Act requires an accurate Register of Members at the registered office; share transfers become effective only upon entry in that register. Vanuatu maintains no public UBO register; instead the appointed VFSC-licensed agent conducts an annual AML/CFT refresh identifying every registrable beneficial owner (10% or more ownership or controlling influence), updates passports, profile and source-of-funds evidence, reconciles the share ledger, and documents any changes. Material ownership changes are recorded immediately in the statutory registers and are included in the next annual confirmation cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger with transfer history)
Register of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Register of Secretaries (if a company secretary is appointed)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - 1,200 per year for a VFSC-licensed registered agent, inclusive of registered office services, agent appointment, government-fee handling and the annual compliance review
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary IFRS audit for a mid-sized intraocular-lens manufacturing entity is typically USD 5,000 - 12,000, or USD 2,000 - 4,000 for an agreed-upon-procedures review

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu International Companies are unconditionally exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend distribution tax, and all future direct taxes under the International Companies Act. The effective tax rate is zero on all worldwide income of the International Company. No statutory tax holiday application is required; the exemption is automatic and perpetual while the annual VFSC license and annual return are maintained. Indirect taxes, including customs duty and 12.5% value-added tax, may apply to physical imports of acrylic polymer raw materials or finished medical lenses, but do not alter the zero CIT rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return prescribed under the International Companies Act and Regulations; filed electronically by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) secure registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation. The annual license fee must also be paid before the anniversary date to maintain good standing; VFSC suspension occurs immediately after the lapse of the statutory payment deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact company name and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation. Do not use trading names or shortened variants; bank mandate cards and letters of credit must match this exact legal name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu and licensed registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed Vanuatu registered agent must be appointed; the agent's physical Port Vila address is the legal and service address. No P.O. Box may be listed as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business and physical operations description.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For this ISIC 3250 scope, disclose the actual high-precision lathe manufacturing facility if operating in Vanuatu. If the IC has no Vanuatu physical establishment, the registered agent's address must be used and the company should clearly indicate no Vanuatu-source sales activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: full legal name, residential address, nationality, date of birth, and passport details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted. Provide notarised and apostilled identity records. Each director must be named in the VFSC beneficial ownership file maintained by the registered agent.

Ownership may be 100% non-resident. All ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed to the registered agent under Vanuatu AML/CFT requirements, although public disclosure is not made through the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, currency denomination, and share classes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement exists. State capital in USD, EUR, or VUV. No share capital duty or stamp duty is payable by an International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity code and product scope.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use ISIC 3250 and include specifically 'manufacture of foldable hydrophobic intraocular acrylic lenses via high-precision lathe turning'. If medical device regulatory approval has been obtained in Vanuatu or abroad, reference the licence number in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of no Vanuatu-sourced trading income and confirmation of zero-tax status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certify that the International Company earns no income derived from Vanuatu sources and does not sell intraocular lenses to Vanuatu residents. This declaration sustains the absolute CIT exemption and prevents the registration from being challenged as an unlicensed local business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts daily interest and a cumulative late surcharge on the annual license fee, often reaching 100% of the base fee if unpaid for several months. VFSC may suspend the Certificate of Good Standing, terminate the company's bank mandate, and initiate automatic strike-off. If struck off, all company assets may be treated as abandoned and directors can be personally liable for contracts entered into after strike-off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and no domestic withholding tax on dividends. Accordingly, no tax treaty relief application is filed in Vanuatu and no Tax Residence Certificate is submitted to a Vanuatu tax authority. For foreign shareholders in their own jurisdictions, the Vanuatu International Company should provide its VFSC certificate of good standing, the annual return proof, and a legal opinion confirming zero Vanuatu CIT. The shareholder then uses its own domestic TRC and CFC analysis to obtain foreign tax relief. Vanuatu does not administratively reduce or exempt dividend withholding because no such tax is levied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for cross-border royalties and debt interest paid by a Vanuatu International Company to non-residents. No treaty rate is applicable. Royalty payments for intraocular lens manufacturing technology and interest on shareholder or intercompany debt instruments may be remitted without Vanuatu withholding tax. Foreign domestic withholding may still arise at the recipient's location; the IC should collect the beneficiary's tax residency evidence for the financial institution under FATCA/CRS due diligence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Vanuatu transfer-pricing documentation threshold exists; in VUV the statutory threshold is effectively zero because no income tax return or TP disclosure is required. For multinational compliance and financial due diligence, the IC should maintain OECD-aligned Master File and Local File documentation when the global group's consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 750 million (approx. VUV 95 billion), and should nonetheless maintain intercompany pricing evidence where cross-border lens sales, royalties, or management fees exceed VUV 30 million (approx. USD 240,000) per annum.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations analogous to BVI or Cayman for International Companies; however, the IC must satisfy the substantive presence expectations of OECD/CRS, anti-money laundering, and correspondent banking standards. For this intraocular lens manufacturer, economic substance is demonstrated by physical manufacturing facilities, calibrated CNC lathe equipment, qualified production staff, inventory contracts, board minutes in Vanuatu, and independent decision-making over polymer pricing and distributors. A passive letterbox entity without operational substance will be recharacterised by foreign tax authorities, blacklisted by payment intermediaries, and denied access to SWIFT Wire and Letter of Credit payment rails.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting the Vanuatu International Company as the true manufacturer of intraocular lenses when production is physically conducted by an affiliated factory elsewhere; knowingly filing a false annual return with fictitious principal business activity; routing lens sales through Vanuatu solely to avoid foreign corporate tax on actual manufacturing profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu criminal law, a director who knowingly makes a materially false statement to VFSC is liable to imprisonment and/or a criminal fine of up to VUV 10,000,000. VFSC may strike off the International Company and confiscate corporate records. Foreign tax authorities may impose back taxes, interest, and civil penalties up to 200% of the underpaid amount, with criminal referral for tax evasion in the manufacturer's actual jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced where the director used the IC as a façade. Directors face personal civil restitution for diverted profits, disqualification from managing companies in Vanuatu and in CRS partner states, travel bans pending foreign investigation, and imprisonment upon criminal conviction for fraud or perjury.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Conduit Substance Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC without any real employees, production premises, or commercial risk; using the IC merely as a conduit to strip margins from the intraocular acrylic lens supply chain through artificially inflated intercompany invoices or circular royalty payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may deny the Certificate of Good Standing and strike off the company for failure to maintain a bona fide registered agent. In onshore jurisdictions, the arrangement is recharacterised as a sham; the Vanuatu margin is allocated back to the actual manufacturing entity, with transfer-pricing penalties of 20% to 40% of the recharacterised profit. The Economic Substance horizontal risk causes all related party payments to be disallowed as deductible expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who signs or approves a sham conduit contract becomes personally liable for consequential loss suffered by group entities. Foreign courts can issue worldwide asset freezing orders, order restitution to the tax authority, and impose director disqualification of up to 15 years. Travel bans are typically imposed where offshore transfers are suspected to be dissipating assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing SWIFT Wire or Letter of Credit payments through the IC for intraocular lens exports without performing enhanced due diligence, splitting invoices to avoid sanctions screening, transacting with entities listed on international sanctions lists, or failing to file suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing framework, money laundering or terrorist financing through a corporate vehicle carries imprisonment of up to 10 years and fines up to VUV 50,000,000. VFIU may freeze and forfeit all bank balances, inventory, and proceeds of lens sales traced to sanctioned transactions. Correspondent banks may additionally terminate all banking relationships with the IC and its directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: AML/CFT compliance officers and directors are personally criminally liable for failing to implement AML controls or intentionally bypassing sanctions checks. There is no corporate veil protection where the director was the controlling mind of the money laundering offence. Senior officers may face extradition requests, travel bans, and personal asset forfeiture.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Medical Device Manufacturing and Customs Misdeclaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Commencing high-precision lathe turning of foldable hydrophobic intraocular acrylic lenses without obtaining the required medical device establishment or product marketing authorization in Vanuatu and in each destination country; misdeclaring HS codes, product descriptions, or quantities on customs declarations to evade customs duty or avoid health authority inspection.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu customs legislation, customs fraud and misdeclaration attract penalties of up to 10 times the evaded duty, forfeiture of the medical lens inventory, and criminal prosecution of the responsible individual. Sale of uncertified intraocular lenses is prohibited by medical device regulators and may prompt emergency product recall, civil product liability claims, and cancellation of export permits in the destination jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false customs declarations are personally liable for customs penalties and may be subjected to criminal imprisonment. In product liability actions, directors of an IC may be named as co-defendants where the lens failed due to non-compliant manufacturing practices. Personal assets, including aircraft, vessels, and foreign bank accounts, may be seized through enforcement of the resulting judgement.
